extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
In Bloomburrow™, the Valley is threatened by elemental forces raging out of control, and salvation falls on the shoulders of its smallest protectors. Players will put their best paws forward, fighting alongside mice, frogs, bats, birds, and myriad other critters to restore the balance of peace—and prove bravery comes in all sizes.
Play Boosters are the ideal booster for the play environment—especially Limited format events. Plus, they're a thrilling pack-opening experience, providing players the opportunity to snag multiple Rare cards or even a possible Booster Fun treatment. A full display of Play Boosters supports a Draft event with extra left over to maximize the fun for your community.
